client_implementation.notes: Seventeen shared screens include creator product/rights selection, private samples, separate license/public-copy consent, submission and withdrawal. SAMPLE has seven durable stages, independent frozen costs, five synthetic roles, native PHOTO media/post/QC and sealed double review. Actual produced PNG/MP4 samples also pass approval, independent registered public copying and public byte downloads without new inference. Other publication cases use explicit READY/QC fixtures only in APP_ENV=test. Public copies have frozen 30-day consent, revoke/expiry/rights/resource checks, fenced recovery and late-PUT cleanup; signed deletion replay preserves RETENTION while USER deletion ends distribution. Native UI, generated/audio/custom-resource samples, production Bundle admission and Plus remain incomplete.

generation_implementation.notes: Both silent generated routes now execute platform-derived references, a released independent identity review, one PRODUCTION role and bounded render_generated_pack, actual generated image/video assembly, explicit POST, route-specific QC, fresh final facts/style reviews and atomic delivery. Reference and final facts runs share the original two-turn facts bucket; five paid roles and twelve tool calls must fit the sold limits. Same-generation role uniqueness, original budget and deadline remain unchanged. Generated source/approval hashes and actual stored bytes are revalidated through post, QC and publication, including inside the publication transaction. Seven complete-pack/rejection/recovery fixtures join the 35 gateway, 6 MCP and 15 reference cases, using native PostgreSQL, actual PNG/MP4, HTTPS and stdio/MCP with synthetic model, usage and isolation. Actual source clip colors and order are checked after final download; no still-animation substitution. Official audio variants, real semantic quality/provider admission, generated SAMPLE/revisions and full variant benchmarks remain incomplete.

native_audio_kernel.notes: Standalone kernel fixtures use native PostgreSQL/FFmpeg/AAC/PNG/PCM with synthetic tones and explicitly manual timecodes. Actual encoded waveforms, subtitle pixels/timing, music-only ducking, revocation, sample counts, loops and cleanup are exercised. The separate native_order_media scope now wraps the kernel in private ORDER PRODUCTION/POST; kernel proof flags still describe its standalone scope. Receipt hashes and signal presence do not certify recognition, semantic listening or complete audible delivery. NATIVE_AUDIO_NOT_ADMITTED remains.

speech_transcription.notes: Native PostgreSQL/FFmpeg/AAC/PCM/private files with synthetic HTTPS transport and transcript/usage responses. Original intent, send marker, task ID, append-only ACK/query/result, source/PCM/WAV hashes and original cost reservation persist. Missing ACK/usage never permits another purchase. Legacy contracts require identical stereo; an explicitly frozen MEAN_STEREO_V1 derivative uses both channels, rejects destructive cancellation and leaves production stereo unchanged. Private POST/QC, original listening, final roles and publication are connected; real recognition/listening/billing and public audio admission remain closed.

native_audio_contract.notes: Native PostgreSQL/FFmpeg/actual AAC plus synthetic character/voice/music authorization, ASR transport/transcript/usage and payment facts. Contract compilation, snapshot hashes, revoked-rights payment refund intent, original budget and concurrent full-track ASR limits are exercised. Fixed prepaid allocation is internal accounting, not proof of an external license purchase. The official multi variant means continuous multi-shot, not required multiple speakers; real cross-shot product/character quality remains unverified. NATIVE_AUDIO_NOT_ADMITTED and all sales-disabled gates remain.

native_order_media.notes: Twenty-three native PostgreSQL/actual AAC-ALAC-PCM/media/HTTPS-stdio-MCP cases with synthetic external model, authorizations, ASR/usage and isolation. Twelve original production/POST/file-QC cases seal complete stereo tracks, original settled ASR and actual caption frames; six foundation cases preserve uncertainty/UNKNOWN and original receipts/costs. Five final-review cases exercise both route deliveries, original-role recovery, exact receipt and billing holds, durable irreversible voice revocation and missing role/tool listening inputs; actual final media now binds full-frame AI disclosure. Positive Chinese/semantic PASS is deliberately fabricated over tone fixtures for control testing, never real hearing certification. No public audio, official continuous multi-shot or real-provider admission. The retained multi-presenter field refers only to an optional multi-speaker extension, not an extra official P0 requirement.

native_audio_qc.notes: Technical file QC retains its original PENDING/REQUIRED historical fields. Complete source/final stereo WAV, original ASR JSON, actual ASS and QC JSON stay immutable. A separate original listening response and fresh final facts/style reports now authorize private publication, with original bytes/rights/costs rechecked at every consumption boundary. Positive semantics are fabricated control fixtures; real-model quality and commercial final-review admission remain false. ASR or a visual report cannot replace the original listening approval.

native_listening.notes: Private platform preparation plus final-role/report/publication integration. FACTS alone prepares or recovers one original request per packet; STYLE, metered inference, report validation and publication read exact original bytes/usage/settlement and complete current stereo/visual material. Both fresh roles receive the full same observation object; inference and controlled tool proofs bind its hash, immutable reports cover the full input and the private manifest links original receipt/result hashes. Original tones remain INSUFFICIENT in negative cases. Positive Chinese PASS is deliberately fabricated to test control bindings, not a speech/listening/billing claim. Seven protocol units and twenty-three order cases include five new final-review/revocation/missing-proof scenarios. All public sales, real listening/cache billing and official variants remain unadmitted.

codex_implementation.scope: CONTENT PLAN, silent PHOTO_LAYOUT/PER_SHOT_AI/REFERENCE_FILM PRODUCTION/POST, private native-audio PER_SHOT_AI/REFERENCE_FILM PRODUCTION/POST/QC with scoped original-track ASR, complete stereo evidence and original paid listening bound through final REVIEW_FACTS/REVIEW_STYLE inputs/inference/tools/immutable reports and transactional native publication, independent generated-reference facts review, metered Responses gateway, atomic silent pack publication, independent seven-stage photo creator SAMPLE pipeline
codex_implementation.limited_revision_notes: Five durable REVISION stages produce a new linked PHOTO_LAYOUT/no-speech manifest for existing-image cover selection, full-pack display order or actual replacement copy bytes. Three new synthetic roles review a new sealed packet; original expiry and original delivery remain intact. Pre-sale frozen aftercare costs share the original total budget across failed retries; UNKNOWN holds are not reset. Stage fencing, recovery, late writes and private role graph are exercised. Generated/audio revisions and real Codex/isolation/device verification remain incomplete. Internal traffic is bounded per live run across all four tool/inference routes; invalid/revoked tokens use the shared IP bucket, and durable cost/tool limits still apply.
codex_implementation.notes: Real HTTPS/MCP, synthetic native stdio roles, persisted planning/photo media and complete sealed visual/text review inputs, original receipt recovery, immutable independent reports, fenced atomic publication and authorized hash-checked downloads are exercised. Independent durable reaping uses registered real Node children and test-only cleanup ports; claims, expired-owner rejection, immutable retries and actual directory guards are exercised. All model judgments, token usage and native isolation assertions remain fixtures. Real Codex, restricted OS identity/process-tree cleanup, certified image cost, semantic quality, official generated/audio variants and bounded repair remain incomplete; both short silent generated pack fixtures have separate native coverage.

lifecycle_implementation.notes: Unpaid creation does not extend TTL; paid frozen inputs retain their entitlement. Private keys are written once and registered before I/O. Maintenance verifies original UNKNOWN bytes, settles durable original Codex/vision receipts after role retirement without purchasing inference, and erases exact objects with immutable attempts. Controlled private DB content is redacted only after binaries, instance release, capabilities, tools and billing settle; the original 32-table checks are extended with private SAMPLE source and role graph coverage in a 33-table policy; immutable per-row digest receipts and database guards reject forged receipts or content restoration. A separate signed hash-chain journal, frozen deletion sets, API/Worker/tool admission gates and original-request replay are exercised against an actual native PostgreSQL pg_dump/pg_restore and restored synthetic file bytes. Malformed legacy locators no longer starve other maintenance requests. Completing controlled privacy replay retains a financial recovery hold; only non-production preview with all paid flags disabled can resume. Off-host checkpoint durability, key rotation, power-loss/ACL guarantees, financial restore, WAL/provider/replica copies, real OSS and production isolation remain unverified. Live WRITING, missing/mismatched original bytes and unsettled billing remain blocked; full privacy completion remains false.
